---
title: "Tuning"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r data}
d <- data.frame(x = 1:40, y = (1:40) * 0.5 + sin(1:40))
```

```{r, fig.height=8}
plot(d$x, d$y)
```

## Step 1

```{r, cache=TRUE}
grid <- c(1, 2)
fits <- lapply(grid, function(k) lm(y ~ poly(x, k), data = d))
best <- grid[which.min(sapply(fits, AIC))]
```

The best degree is `r best`.

## Step 2

```{r, cache=TRUE}
grid <- c(best, best + 1, best + 2)
fits <- lapply(grid, function(k) lm(y ~ poly(x, k), data = d))
best <- grid[which.min(sapply(fits, AIC))]
d$fitted <- fitted(fits[[which(grid == best)]])
```

```{r}
d$fitted[1:3]
leftover_from_the_console()
```
